The B page contains the finite two-mode example, with its scope limited to oscillator factors. The plan/design discrepancies and the mismatch with the planned C* rescaling theorem are recorded in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-118.notes.md).
